title: Senate Under Hollow Witness: Realm Answer

lore: Senate Under Hollow Witness: Realm Answer advances Laurel Senate Trials: Olympus turns the reopened Gate into public trial law, forcing glory to become defense instead of vanity. It directly tests the faction tension: Glory unites them in public and divides them in private; every victory creates a jealous shadow.
